purpose: Pre-registered sensitivity grid on a refreshed historical candidate universe. Cross 108 dispersion/momentum parameter combinations with two universe arms, for 216 cells. This is not a winner-rescue or guarantee of profitability.

primary_test.statement: Extreme cross-sectional return dispersion weakens the subsequent cross-sectional momentum spread.
primary_test.primary_endpoint: mean formation-level high-minus-low spread, net of registered 1x base costs, with historical funding included where available
primary_test.rule: The registered directional test controls the H1 verdict. The complete grid is exploratory. A positive result is an alternative hypothesis candidate, not a retroactive rewrite of H1.

axes.name: momentum_lookback_days
axes.definition: Calendar days of completed UTC daily returns for formation-time cross-sectional momentum.

axes.name: forward_horizon_days
axes.definition: Calendar-day forward outcome horizon; use the frozen non-overlapping formation phase for each horizon.

axes.name: dispersion_estimator
axes.definition: Cross-sectional standard deviation or 1.4826 times median absolute deviation across eligible assets' trailing momentum returns.

axes.name: dispersion_window_days
axes.definition: Prior calendar-day history used to estimate dispersion-state thresholds; never include the current or future state in its own threshold.

axes.name: dispersion_state_rule
axes.definition: Outer-decile high/low classification or a median split using only prior valid dispersion observations.

axes.name: universe_arm
axes.definition: Legacy comparator is capped at existing mapped assets. Expanding arm uses verified descending historical point-in-time market-cap ranks without a fixed top-N limit.

enumeration.value_order: Cartesian product in listed axis order and value order; no adaptive ordering.
enumeration.canonical_config_identity: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, separators comma/colon and no insignificant whitespace; SHA-256 the exact canonical string.
enumeration.primary_anchor_definition: 30-day lookback, 30-day forward horizon, cross-sectional population standard deviation, 365-day dispersion window, trailing-window outer deciles, expanding_point_in_time universe.

fixed_rules.formation_clock: Completed UTC daily bars only. Freeze the monthly formation phase before outcome computation.
fixed_rules.point_in_time_universe: Historical market-cap rank and eligibility must be known by the formation timestamp. Current rank is discovery-only.
fixed_rules.portfolio: Equal-weight top momentum decile long and bottom decile short, no overlap; deterministic asset-ID tie breaking.
fixed_rules.data_gates: No price/rank/funding forward-fill. Keep missingness and instrument lifecycle explicit.
fixed_rules.costs: Run registered 1x baseline cost and 2x/3x stress cases; never select the cheapest case based on results.
fixed_rules.funding: Use historical funding sign and settlement timing; report funding separately from price/basis PnL.
fixed_rules.dev_sample: Full grid on discovery/validation only; report actual timestamp boundaries and all expected terminal cells.
fixed_rules.future_sample: Forward block begins 2025-01-01 and ends at the latest fully closed UTC daily candle frozen in preregistration. Evaluate only the single frozen anchor on that block.
fixed_rules.selection: Holm correction across all 216 sensitivity cells for the registered 1x net endpoint. Two-sided exploratory estimates; H1 directional verdict remains negative. No grid rescue of a failed primary test.
fixed_rules.continuation: Blocked cells remain in the ledger; continue other valid candidate cells and non-data tasks. Resume idempotently; do not stop after unfavorable results.
